GitHub Copilot just added Kimi K2.7 Code by Moonshot AI to the model lineup. As our very first open-weight model in the Copilot model picker, it offers powerful agentic coding capabilities at a highly efficient price point. Watch Burke Holland explain how to enable it in your model picker and see how it performs on a full product requirements document. This model is available today for Pro, Pro+, and Max users.
